## Added

- New `dossier` command: assembles the whole-dossier annotation — per-page
  labels, text-extraction routing, decoded QR payloads, entities, groups and a
  derived document graph, with the `vector` classification and georeferencing
  folded in. Pages deterministic extraction cannot read (scans, handwriting,
  mis-encoded text layers) carry an `extraction.vlm` work order; a second run
  with `--answers <file>` merges the vision pass's results. With `--output`,
  each drawing page's GeoJSON is written under `geojson/<document>/` and
  referenced from `pages[].cad.geojson`.
- `docs/annotation-schema.md`: the annotation's field reference (schema
  version 0.2.0) and the `--answers` file format. `docs/json-api.md` gained
  the matching `dossier` contract section.
- QR decoding (pure Rust, `rxing`): two-tier — a 1400 px pass over every
  page, and a 3000 px retry for scans and e-cadastre-templated pages.
- Mis-encoded text-layer detection: legacy 8-bit (ArmSCII-style) and
  custom-glyph font mappings are flagged as `extraction.encoding_issue` and
  VLM-routed instead of being emitted as confident mojibake.
- `dossier --vlm [model]`: the vision pass can run in-process against a
  hosted model. Bare `--vlm` uses `gemini-3.8-flash`, the corpus benchmark's
  winner — `gemini-*` specs via the Gemini API (`GEMINI_API_KEY`),
  `vendor/model` specs via OpenRouter (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`). This is the
  toolkit's **only** networked path and is opt-in per invocation; it sends
  the flagged pages' images to the configured provider. Pages covered by
  `--answers` are not re-asked. Model comparison on the corpus task is in
  `docs/annotation-findings.md`.

## Changed

- Contract version is now **0.9.0**. Existing command outputs are unchanged;
  the release is additive.
- Toolchain and dependencies moved to latest stable: Rust 1.98
  (`rust-version = "1.98"`), `clap` 4.6, `lopdf` 0.45, `pdfium-render` 0.9.4,
  and refreshed transitive locks. The corpus suite passes unchanged on the
  updated stack.
